notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes: [p]Just released a new demo update! This version brings important bug fixes, improved balance, and gameplay adjustments to give you a clearer glimpse of the final experience. Dive in and let us know your feedback—it’s a big step toward launch![/p]

notes.title: Publisher announcement
notes.notes:
After years of working solo on my passion project, I’m thrilled to announce that I’ve partnered with publisher [url=http://indie.io]indie.io[/url] to bring my game to the world! This journey has been a long, challenging, and deeply rewarding labor of love—built in silence, fuelled by persistence, and soon ready to be shared.

With their support, the game will reach new heights, and I can’t wait for you all to experience it. Thank you to everyone who believed in me along the way. More details soon—the adventure is just beginning!

I recommend checking out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]their page[/url] to see other indie games they are supporting.

notes.title: INDIGO Design Award Gold Winner
notes.notes:
I’m overjoyed to share that I Mother has won GOLD at the 2025 INDIGO Design Awards!  This recognition truly validates the years of hard work and dedication poured into this project.
